summary: Simulated concurrent update resulting in stale expectedVersion 409 conflict during fact mutation. The client successfully handled validation_failed/stale_version without discarding user input, prominently displayed .bh-conflict-alert in drawer ('Bu Marka Kiti başka bir oturum tarafından değiştirildi. Lütfen yeniden yükleyin.') and main surface with action button[data-action='bh-retry'].
